label_rationale: claimTips and tip share a nonReentrant lock held across the call
mechanism: tip jar: creators claim accumulated tips
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['_status', 'cash', 'owed', 'tips']

ghost_state.name: inFlight
ghost_state.meaning: payout sent to the caller whose owed and tips updates are deferred past the call

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

mcvp_rounds.ag_spec_rendered:
Assume-Guarantee specification for TipJar_CR02b
  target property phi : cash >= owed
  exposure site       : claimTips.call  (low-level call)
  ghost state         : uint256 inFlight

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During claimTips's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['tip', 'claimTips']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {cash >= owed && _status == 1} pre-phase {cash + inFlight >= owed && tips[caller] >= inFlight && _status == 2}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = cash + inFlight >= owed && tips[caller] >= inFlight && _status == 2)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_tip', 'OBL_cb_claimTips']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {cash >= owed && _status == 1 /\ inFlight==0}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => cash >= owed
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['tip', 'claimTips'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback tip preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.purpose: callback claimTips preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
